title: kit-rules rule set
description: Shared rule data for language-specific kits. Store rule words without configured whitespace. Consumers remove that whitespace from matching input and apply ASCII case normalization to both input and rule words while preserving source credit labels and names. Consumers check unique group IDs and alias conflicts, and perform model changes. Node kits may statically import the JSON with Vite.

$schema.description: Relative reference to the shared repository schema.

version.description: Rule format version. Consumers accept only versions they support.

language.description: Lowercase text language tag. Use the same tag in the corresponding filename.

groups.description: A file contains one group type. Preserve source group and word order. Consumers check that group IDs are unique within the file.

oneOf.title: Credit rule file
oneOf.description: Split a full line at its first ASCII or fullwidth colon. Remove configured whitespace from the role-label copy, apply ASCII case normalization, and compare it with compact rule words for whole-string equality. Name separators are consumer options. Preserve source labels and names; a label without a valid name does not produce a credit.

oneOf.title: Filter rule file
oneOf.description: Remove configured whitespace from a matching-text copy before applying filter conditions. This makes separated and compact spellings equivalent. Categories identify text; consumer options decide whether to remove a lyric line.

normalization.title: Match normalization
normalization.description: Normalize matching copies only; stored rule words contain no configured whitespace. The whitespace set is U+0009..U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000..U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, and U+FEFF. All implementations process the same code points.

whitespace.description: Remove every configured whitespace character from matching input. Both credit and filter rules use remove; preserve the original source text.

case.description: Lowercase ASCII A through Z only. Preserve every other character and avoid platform-default locale rules.

groupId.description: Stable group identifier using lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

words.description: Ordered compact literal words without duplicate items or configured whitespace. Consumers apply ASCII case normalization to stored words and check alias conflicts across groups.

creditRole.description: Current model CreditRole symbol. Each implementation maps it explicitly instead of relying on enum numbers.

roles.description: A label may resolve to multiple roles, such as LYRICIST and COMPOSER for a combined credit.

kind.description: role identifies a credit responsibility; instrument identifies an instrument credit. Consumers perform metadata updates.

filterMatch.description: contains finds any case-normalized rule word as a substring of whitespace-free matching text without word-boundary checks. whole requires the complete matching text to equal a rule word under the same case policy. Using whole for Cover does not match Discover.

category.description: Identification category using lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. The category does not prescribe a deletion action.
